Detailed Description

mDNS service discovery UI wrapper for interactive server selection

Pure TUI wrapper that calls discovery_mdns_query() from discovery.c. Provides interactive terminal UI for server selection and address resolution.

            ui_mdns_server_t * ui_mdns_query (const
            ui_mdns_config_t * config, int * out_count)
          

          

            TUI wrapper around core mDNS discovery. Discover ascii-chat servers
            on the local network via mDNS.
          

          

          

            Calls discovery_mdns_query() from discovery.c with
            TUI-friendly configuration.
          

          

          
TUI wrapper around core mDNS discovery.

          

          

            Performs an mDNS query for _ascii-chat._tcp services on the local
            network. Collects responses and returns discovered servers to the
            caller.
          

          

          
Behavior:

          
    
            
  • 
              Sends multicast mDNS query for _ascii-chat._tcp.local services
            
    • 
            
  • Waits for responses for the specified timeout period
    • 
            
  • 
              Collects all discovered servers with their addresses and ports
            
    • 
            
  • Returns array of discovered servers
    • 
          

          
Memory Management:

          
    
            
  • 
              Caller is responsible for freeing the returned array with
              ui_mdns_free_results()
            
    • 
            
  • 
              Returned servers are valid until ui_mdns_free_results() is
              called
            
    • 
          

          
Error Handling:

          
    
            
  • Returns NULL and sets errno on initialization failure
    • 
            
  • 
              Partial results returned if mDNS init fails but discovery was
              attempted
            
    • 
            
  • Network errors logged but don't prevent continuation
    • 
          

          
Threading:

          
    
            
  • Blocking operation - waits for full timeout period
    • 
            
  • Safe to call from main thread
    • 
            
  • Does not spawn background threads
    • 
          

          
Parameters

          

            config Discovery configuration (NULL uses defaults)
            

            out_count Output parameter: number of discovered servers
          

          
Returns

          

            Array of discovered servers, or NULL on error Must be freed with
            ui_mdns_free_results()
          

          
Note

          

            Timeout includes network round-trip time, so 2000ms allows ~1.5s of
            actual waiting
            

            

              Returns empty array (non-NULL with count=0) if no servers found,
              not NULL
            

          

          
Example:

          

          
ui_mdns_config_t config = {.timeout_ms = 2000, .max_servers = 20};
int count = 0;
ui_mdns_server_t *servers = ui_mdns_query(&config, &count);
if (servers && count > 0) {


    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {


        printf("%d: %s (%s:%d)\n", i+1, servers[i].name, servers[i].address, servers[i].port);


    }


    // User selects server...


    ui_mdns_free_results(servers);
}

            int ui_mdns_select_live (const ui_mdns_server_t * servers,
              int count, uint64_t deadline, ui_mdns_server_t *
              chosen)
          

          

            Background LAN discovery while choosing; copies the selected
            endpoint into chosen. Returns 0 on selection, -1 on cancellation.
            Selection follows endpoint identity as the list changes; the worker
            is stopped and joined before returning.
